# mabinogi-012 — establishment log (2026-11-14)

Evans 1907 cols 89 l. 11 – 94 l. 10 (PDF pp. 77–79). Every column read on the page image (zoom 4, two crops per
column; zoom 10–16 for single lines). Base: Evans's letters as on the image; the second witness used only to locate
disagreements and for punctuation and paragraph shape (the pilot's practice). 6-shaped w → w; r-rotunda → r;
ſ → s; raised letters into the line; letters Evans prints with a single dot beneath (the scribe's expunction) left
out; line-end marks and Evans's dotted/wavy underlines and suspension strokes (keis̲, chan̲, e6ẏllus, ehut-, garw,
rwymedigaeth, o bob un ohonawch, Ac o achaws …) dropped. Red Book = Rhŷs & Evans 1905 (source/raw/rhys-evans1905_djvu.txt).

Tooling note: page 77 cols at x ≈ 0–135 / 125–235; page 78 (even) x ≈ 85–215 / 200–332; page 79 as 77. Text y ≈ 40–405.

## Opening and close
- col 89 l. 11 — the part begins mid-line after "… ac eu harueu can mwyaf." (011's close): "Gwyr gwyned a
  ymchweles". No large initial.
- Close: col 94 ll. 9–10 "a hwnnw a uu trydyd anuat er|gyt." — 013 begins on the same line, "Val yd oed Wydyon …".

## Worklist items (24 check + 20 loss), decided on the image
OCR misreadings of Evans's sorts where the image agrees with the witness: col 89 ll. 11 (mwyaf, Gwyr), 13
(orawenus), 16 (a wystlyssant), 19 (a'r gwystlon), 23 (a gyrchyssant), 27 (beris), 28 (see below); col 90 ll. 10
(uyg kyuoeth), 13 (y gylchaw), 15 (a'y llynn), 18 (heb wynt — Evans *6ẏnᵗ*, raised t into the line), 26
(ewyllus), 28 (e hutlath), 31 (mynhei); col 91 l. 15 (see below), l. 23 (a baraf), l. 36 (ynteu — Evans prints it;
the witness's brackets are Williams's, not the White Book's); col 92 l. 3 (chrynllwdyn), l. 34 (A wyr); col 93
ll. 1 (o bob un), 5–6 (kyrchyssant, A wyr), 9–10 (geisswyf, y Guydyon), 16 (y kymerth), 17 (dros), 20 (dros yr),
29 (yn y gylch); col 94 ll. 2 (annyan), 7 (A'r ergyt).

Expunged letters (dot beneath; left out):
- col 89 l. 28 — **"ual y caei"**: Evans *ẏ caṛei*, the r dotted beneath → *caei* (witness *caei*; Red Book *kaffei*).
- col 93 l. 4 — **"A guedy ymgueiraw"**: Evans ends l. 4 *Aguedẏ ỵ̇* with the line-final y dotted beneath (a
  repeated y cancelled before *ymgueiraw* on l. 5) → left out (witness agrees).

Raised letters (into the line):
- col 90 l. 18 — *heb wynt* (raised t).
- col 93 l. 2 — **"a golchi"**: Evans *agochi* with *l* raised over the o/c → *golchi* (witness and Red Book *golchi*).

Where Evans differs from the witness (Evans adopted):
- col 90 l. 23 — **"o wyr ac arueu"**: Evans *arueu* (Red Book *arueu*); the witness's *araeu* is its typo.
- col 90 l. 30 — "Ac achub": Evans prints the capital-a sort; OCR "Ec" is a misreading.
- col 93 l. 31 — **"Ie, heb mab Mathonwy"**: Evans *Je heb mab math|onwy*; the witness's "[Math uab]" is Williams's
  supplement (Red Book *heb y math mab mathonwy*). Not supplied: the White Book's "said the son of Mathonwy" reads.

Scribal slips kept as written (readable; for the drafter's notes):
- col 91 l. 15 — **"trillydyn eodynt"** for *oedynt* (letters transposed; Red Book *oedynt*). Certain at zoom 10.
- col 91 l. 34 — **"llyma y clywyn"**: Evans *ẏclẏ6ẏn*; Red Book *y clywynt* — *clywyn* is either a slip for
  *clywynt* or for *clywei* (as at col 91 l. 6, col 92 l. 20); the witness keeps *clywyn*.
- col 92 l. 20 — **"llyma y chywei dygyuor"**: Evans *ẏchẏ6ei* — certain at zoom 10; a slip for *clywei* (Red Book
  *cly6ei*; witness silently corrects).
- col 93 l. 5 — **"ymgueiraw ohonut"**: Evans *o honut* (no second n) for *ohonunt* (Red Book *ohonunt*). The o
  carries a short dotted underline (three dots), not a single expunction dot; read as a mark and kept. Uncertain.
- col 93 l. 15 — **"Ny wnn ni amgen no'm bot"**: Evans *nẏ 6nn ni* — certain at zoom 10. The *ni* is apparently the
  pronoun *i* with the n of *wnn* written twice (Red Book *y wnn i arglwyd amgen nom bot*; witness *Ny wnn i*).

Not supplied (the White Book has no gap and the sense reads):
- col 90 l. 6 — "yr hynn a allaf i, mi a baraf iawn y ti yn gyntaf": the Red Book has "y2 hynn a allaf mi ae g6naf mi
  a baraf itt gael ia6n"; the witness's "[mi a'e gwnaf]" is not supplied. NOTE FOR DRAFTER: the clause *yr hynn a
  allaf i* stands without its verb in the White Book (probably an eye-skip from *mi a'e gwnaf* to *mi a baraf*).

Other forms kept for notes:
- Giluaethwy (cols 89, 90, 92) and Giluathwy (col 90 l. 29); Guydyon / Gwydyon; Goewyn; Caer Tathyl.
- *Enteu* (twice, col 89) for *ynteu*; *e ystauell*, *e hutlath* (e for y, as in 011).
- *coed* / *coet* both used (baed coed, moch coet, garnen coet).
- *yleni* and *eleni* side by side (col 91, 92).
- *uab braswineu* (col 92 l. 7) — Red Book *bzafwineu*.
- *Hydwn*, *Hychdwn*, *Bleidwn*; the three-line verse (Tri meib Giluaethwy enwir …) printed by Evans as running text;
  kept inline in its unit.
- *ywchwitheu* (col 91 l. 3) — *ywch* + *chwitheu*, as written.
- *a uyrywys Gouannon y ewythyr* — Red Book has the same.
- *arnaw* (col 93 l. 26, *yr eil olwc arnaw*) — Red Book *arnei*; kept (the White Book's 'on it' = the thing).

No words supplied; no blanks in Evans's text; no marginal marks.
